root.name: OtterWorks
root.description: Polyglot multi-tenant collaboration platform (files, documents, real-time editing) behind a Go API gateway. Indexed with emphasis on the local core profile: api-gateway, auth-service, file-service, document-service, client web-app and Postgres/Redis/LocalStack/Meilisearch.

children.name: Edge & Identity
children.description: Go api-gateway (chi) that terminates every /api/v1 request: JWT validation, identity header rewriting, rate limiting, CORS, circuit breaking and proxying to backend services.

children.name: Gateway Middleware Chain
children.description: Bootstraps the gateway and composes the global middleware order (request id, real IP, metrics, logging, recoverer, compression, rate limit, CORS, JWT) before mounting the proxy router.

children.name: Gateway JWT Middleware
children.description: Validates HS256 Bearer tokens on protected route prefixes, skipping exact public paths (login/register) and prefix paths (/health, /metrics, /socket.io); stores claims in request context.

children.name: Identity Header Strip/Inject Proxy
children.description: Reverse-proxy director that deletes client-supplied X-User-ID / X-User-Email and re-injects them only from validated JWT claims (sub or user_id, email).

children.name: Service Route Table
children.description: Maps /api/v1 prefixes (auth, files, folders, documents, templates, settings, collab, search, ...) to backend URLs and mounts one proxy handler per prefix with a JSON 404 fallback.

children.name: Gateway Config & Secret Loading
children.description: Env-driven configuration: backend URLs, JWT_SECRET (validated non-empty at startup), CORS lists, rate limit and circuit breaker tuning.

children.name: Per-IP Rate Limiting
children.description: Token-bucket limiter keyed on client IP (X-Forwarded-For / RemoteAddr) returning 429 with Retry-After, with periodic bucket cleanup.

children.name: CORS Policy
children.description: Origin allow-list CORS middleware with credentials, exposed headers and preflight short-circuit; supports wildcard origins.

children.name: Circuit Breaker
children.description: Per-route-prefix circuit breaker that trips on failure ratio and returns 503 while open; wraps the proxy handler with a status recorder.

children.name: Gateway Telemetry
children.description: Request ID propagation, structured zerolog access logs, Prometheus request metrics with path normalisation, health endpoint and OTLP tracing setup.

children.name: Accounts & Auth
children.description: Spring Boot auth-service owning users, roles, refresh tokens and settings; issues the JWTs every other service trusts.

children.name: Registration & Login
children.description: POST /api/v1/auth/register and /login: validates DTOs, creates users with default role, verifies credentials and returns access + refresh tokens.

children.name: JWT Token Issuance
children.description: JwtTokenProvider signs access/refresh JWTs (sub, email, roles, jti) with the configured secret and validates/parses them; JwtConfig binds jwt.* properties.

children.name: Token Refresh & Logout
children.description: POST /refresh exchanges a refresh JWT (checked against persisted, non-revoked refresh tokens) for a new pair; /logout revokes the user's refresh tokens.

children.name: Password Hashing & Change
children.description: BCrypt PasswordEncoder bean plus the change-password flow that verifies the current password before re-hashing.

children.name: Spring Security Filter Chain
children.description: Stateless SecurityFilterChain declaring public vs authenticated endpoints and the JwtAuthFilter that turns Bearer tokens into an Authentication.

children.name: Profile & User Directory
children.description: GET/PUT /profile, user lookup by email or id (used by sharing flows) and admin user listing backed by UserService and the User/Role entities.

children.name: User Settings
children.description: GET/PATCH /api/v1/settings for per-user preferences, persisted in user_settings.

children.name: Auth Config, Health & Errors
children.description: application*.yml (datasource, jwt.secret with dev default, token expiries), global exception mapping, DB health endpoint and logging config.

children.name: Document Domain
children.description: FastAPI document-service: rich-text documents with versions, comments, templates, share links and exports on PostgreSQL.

children.name: Document Service Bootstrap & Config
children.description: FastAPI app factory with CORS, router registration and lifespan DB init; pydantic Settings (DOC_SVC_ prefix) for DB URL, SNS, CORS; health/metrics endpoints.

children.name: Caller Identity & Ownership Checks
children.description: Extracts the user from the Authorization JWT (HS256/HS384 with JWT_SECRET) or, when no secret is configured, from the forwarded X-User-ID header; enforces owner-only access.

children.name: Document CRUD API
children.description: Create/get/update/patch/delete document endpoints and the DocumentService ORM operations behind them, including word counts and automatic version snapshots.

children.name: Listing, Metadata Filtering & Search
children.description: GET /documents list with optional owner/folder/title/content_type/sort filters routed to DocumentQueryRepository (raw SQL text built from f-strings), plus the ORM-based /search endpoint.

children.name: Document Share Links
children.description: POST /{id}/share mints a share token and GET /shared?document_id&token resolves it; tokens are MD5(document_id:salt) with SHARE_LINK_SALT defaulting to a static value.

children.name: Exports & Export Archive
children.description: GET /{id}/export renders HTML/Markdown/text exports; GET /exports?name= reads a named file from the export archive directory via os.path.join + open().

children.name: Document Versioning
children.description: List document versions and restore a prior version, snapshotting current content first.

children.name: Document Comments
children.description: Add, list and delete comments on a document.

children.name: Document Templates
children.description: List/create templates and instantiate a new document from a template.

children.name: File Storage
children.description: Rust/actix file-service: uploads to S3, file/folder/version/share metadata in DynamoDB, trash and activity feeds.

children.name: File Service Bootstrap & Config
children.description: actix-web server wiring (route table for /api/v1/files and /api/v1/folders), env config for AWS endpoints/tables/SNS, error mapping and request-id middleware.

children.name: Upload Pipeline
children.description: Multipart upload handler: resolves owner from X-User-ID (or form field), builds the S3 key files/{owner}/{id}, uploads, writes metadata + first version and emits file_uploaded.

children.name: S3 Object Storage Client
children.description: Thin AWS SDK S3 client: put/get/delete/copy objects and presigned download URLs against LocalStack or AWS.

children.name: DynamoDB Metadata Client
children.description: MetadataClient for file items plus attribute parsing helpers and the domain models (FileMetadata, Folder, FileVersion, FileShare, request/response DTOs).

children.name: File Listing, Ownership & Activity
children.description: Get metadata, list files / shared-with-me / trash and the activity feed; owner resolution prefers the gateway-injected X-User-ID over the owner_id query param.

children.name: Download via Presigned URL
children.description: GET /{id}/download looks up metadata by id and returns a one-hour presigned S3 URL.

children.name: File Lifecycle (Move/Rename/Trash/Delete)
children.description: Delete, move, rename, trash and restore handlers and the conditional DynamoDB updates behind them.

children.name: File Versions
children.description: List stored versions of a file and persist new version records.

children.name: File Sharing
children.description: Share a file with a user id or email (permission levels), remove shares, and the share table queries; publishes file_shared and raises alerts on notification failures.

children.name: Folder Model
children.description: Folder CRUD endpoints and DynamoDB folder table operations.

children.name: Data Stores
children.description: Local infrastructure from docker-compose.infra.yml backing the core profile: PostgreSQL, Redis, LocalStack (S3/DynamoDB/SNS/SQS) and Meilisearch.

children.name: PostgreSQL Instance
children.description: postgres:15 container (otterworks/otterworks_dev) with init script creating extra databases.

children.name: Auth Schema (Flyway + JPA)
children.description: Flyway migrations for users, roles, refresh_tokens and user_settings and the User/Role JPA entities and repositories.

children.name: Document Schema (Alembic + SQLAlchemy)
children.description: Alembic migration for documents, versions, comments, templates; SQLAlchemy models, async engine/session and Pydantic schemas.

children.name: Redis
children.description: redis:7 with LRU eviction; holds chaos flags, collab state and caches.

children.name: LocalStack S3 Buckets
children.description: LocalStack emulating AWS; provisions otterworks-files, data-lake and audit-archive buckets and restores S3 seed data on boot.

children.name: DynamoDB Tables
children.description: LocalStack DynamoDB tables for file metadata, folders, versions, shares, audit events and notifications.

children.name: Meilisearch
children.description: Meilisearch v1.6 full-text index used by search-service.

children.name: Web Client
children.description: React + Vite SPA (frontend/client-app) served by nginx, talking to the gateway through a same-origin /api/v1 proxy.

children.name: App Shell & Routing
children.description: React Router route table, layout shell, sidebar/breadcrumb, landing and dashboard pages and query provider.

children.name: Axios API Client
children.description: Shared axios instance: attaches Bearer token from localStorage, camelCases responses and handles 401 by re-verifying /auth/profile and redirecting to login.

children.name: Same-Origin /api/v1 Proxy
children.description: nginx (prod) and Vite dev server proxy forwarding /api/v1/* to API_GATEWAY_URL with a 100 MB body limit and websocket upgrade.

children.name: Login, Registration & Session
children.description: Login/register pages, auth API calls and the zustand auth store holding tokens in localStorage.

children.name: Files UI
children.description: File browser, detail, upload dropzone, share dialog, trash/shared/recent/starred views and the filesApi/storageApi calls.

children.name: Documents UI & Editor
children.description: Document list, card and the collaborative editor with presence avatars plus documentsApi calls.

children.name: Search & Notifications UI
children.description: Search page/bar and notifications page/bell with searchApi, notificationsApi and activityApi.

children.name: Settings, Margins & Billing UI
children.description: User settings page, analytics margins page and billing plan/entitlement pages with their API modules.

children.name: Contracts & Eventing
children.description: Shared API/event contracts and the SNS/SQS fan-out that decouples core services from downstream consumers.

children.name: OpenAPI & Proto Contracts
children.description: OpenAPI specs for document, search and notification services; proto directory placeholder.

children.name: Event Schemas
children.description: JSON Schemas for file, document, collaboration, notification and audit events.

children.name: SNS/SQS Event Bus
children.description: otterworks-events SNS topic fanned out to notification, audit and search SQS queues, provisioned in LocalStack.

children.name: File Event Publisher
children.description: Publishes file_uploaded/deleted/shared/trashed/restored/updated/moved events to SNS.

children.name: Document Event Publisher
children.description: boto3 SNS publisher for document lifecycle events (enabled via DOC_SVC_SNS_ENABLED).

children.name: Upload/Share Failure Alerts
children.description: Builds and posts signed alert payloads to admin-service when uploads or share notifications fail.

children.name: Platform Services
children.description: Non-core services in the full profile (summary nodes only).

children.name: Collaboration Service
children.description: Node/TypeScript Socket.IO + Yjs real-time co-editing with JWT socket auth and Redis adapter.

children.name: Search Service
children.description: Python search API and SQS-driven indexer over Meilisearch.

children.name: Notification Service
children.description: Kotlin/Ktor notifications: SQS consumer, DynamoDB repository, websocket push and preferences routes.

children.name: Admin Service & Dashboard
children.description: Rails admin API (users, quotas, chaos, incidents/alerts triage) and the Angular admin dashboard.

children.name: Audit Service
children.description: .NET audit trail consuming SNS/SQS events into DynamoDB with S3 archiving.

children.name: Report Service
children.description: Spring Boot report generation over its own otterworks_reports database.

children.name: Analytics Service
children.description: Scala analytics: event ingest, usage rollups and margin analytics routes.

children.name: Billing Service
children.description: Python billing plans and tenant entitlements.

children.name: Runtime, Secrets & Resilience
children.description: How the core profile is composed and configured locally, where shared secrets come from, chaos hooks, observability and (summarised) Kubernetes deployment.

children.name: Compose Core Profile
children.description: docker-compose service definitions for api-gateway, auth, file, document and web-app with their env wiring to Postgres/Redis/LocalStack.

children.name: Shared JWT Secret Distribution
children.description: JWT_SECRET is injected into gateway, auth, file and document services from compose (dev default) and read by each service's config.

children.name: Chaos Flags
children.description: Redis-backed chaos switches checked by file and document services (upload S3 errors, slow queries) and the bug catalog / injector scripts.

children.name: Observability Stack
children.description: Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger, OTel collector and Fluent Bit containers.

children.name: Kubernetes Deployment (summary)
children.description: Helm charts and tenant deploy script used for EKS tenants; summarised only.
